test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Amir, Bineet, Chandra, Dinesh, Indresh, Farukh, Gurmeet and Hariom are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table. Four of them are sitting at the corners, while four are sitting at the middle of the sides. Indresh sits third to the left of Gurmeet. Indresh sits at one of the comers. Bineet sits second to the right of Farukh. Farukh does not sit at any of the corners. Farukh is not an immediate neighbour of Indresh. Hariom is an immediate neighbour of Amir. Hariom does not sit at any of the middle of the sides. Only three people sit between Hariom and Chandra. Who sits third to the left of Dinesh?
solution:
Given: Amir, Bineet, Chandra, Dinesh, Indresh, Farukh, Gurmeet and Hariom. 

Four of them are sitting at the corners, while four are sitting at the middle of the sides. 

1) Indresh sits third to the left of Gurmeet. 

2) Indresh sits at one of the comers. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/975061b3a241f82cab1517226f99c52cdc7fc946c438dceae4a129de011e2286.png] 

3) Farukh is not an immediate neighbour of Indresh.

4) Farukh does not sit at any of the corners.

5) Bineet sits second to the right of Farukh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/007201aebc6d68aa353526181251f89d3654c47a9d3012324b2fe4be694f4192.png] 

6) Hariom is an immediate neighbour of Amir.

7) Hariom does not sit at any of the middle of the sides (It means Hariom will sit on the immediate left of Gurmeet).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4962bcd9d2b7a3c80f029cd2cd68fe0b9b29937b0e2d39eebebcce299b8fe92d.png] 

8) Only three people sit between Hariom and Chandra.

And, Dinesh will sit on the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/685d25ba46a51da2f05c11ab40db442351ec6df18daf784624552e592741104b.png] 

So, 'Amir' sits third to the left of Dinesh.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
